verse_text: וְאֶת־כָּל־חֵילָ֤ם וְאֶת־כָּל־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם שָׁב֖וּ וַיָּבֹ֑זּוּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּֽיִת׃
context_detail: capture and plunder after the massacre at Shechem
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ואת־כל־טפם ואת־נשיהם שבו
working_translation: and they took captive all their little ones and their wives
classification_note: The finite verb שבו, 'they took captive', directly governs the little ones and wives.

verse_text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֗יו שִׁלְחָ֥ה הַנַּ֛עַר אִתִּ֖י וְנָק֣וּמָה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְנִֽחְיֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת גַּם־אֲנַ֥חְנוּ גַם־אַתָּ֖ה גַּם־טַפֵּֽנוּ׃
context_detail: a journey undertaken so that the household may survive famine
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ונחיה ולא נמות גם־אנחנו גם־אתה גם־טפנו
working_translation: so that we may live and not die—we, you, and our little ones
classification_note: Travel is proposed, but the clause itself climaxes in the survival of the whole household, including the little ones.

verse_text: וְאַתָּ֥ה צֻוֵּ֖יתָה זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ־לָכֶם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם עֲגָלֹ֗ות לְטַפְּכֶם֙ וְלִנְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וּנְשָׂאתֶ֥ם אֶת־אֲבִיכֶ֖ם וּבָאתֶֽם׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: state-assisted household migration to Egypt
relevant_hebrew_phrase: קחו־לכם מארץ מצרים עגלות לטפכם ולנשיכם
working_translation: take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and your wives
classification_note: The wagons are expressly provided to transport the little ones and wives.

verse_text: וַיָּ֥קָם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם בָּעֲגָלֹ֕ות אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח פַּרְעֹ֖ה לָשֵׂ֥את אֹתֹֽו׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: household migration from Canaan to Egypt
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישאו בני־ישראל את־יעקב אביהם ואת־טפם ואת־נשיהם בעגלות
working_translation: the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, their little ones, and their wives in the wagons
classification_note: The little ones are named among those physically transported in the migration.

verse_text: וַיְכַלְכֵּ֤ל יֹוסֵף֙ אֶת־אָבִ֣יו וְאֶת־אֶחָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יו לֶ֖חֶם לְפִ֥י הַטָּֽף׃
context_detail: food allocation according to household need
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ויכלכל יוסף את־אביו ואת־אחיו ואת כל־בית אביו לחם לפי הטף
working_translation: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and his father's whole household with food according to the number and needs of the dependants
classification_note: לפי הטף is literally 'according to the mouth of the טף'; in context it measures household food by the number or needs of its dependants.

verse_text: וְהָיָה֙ בַּתְּבוּאֹ֔ת וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם חֲמִישִׁ֖ית לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע הַיָּדֹ֡ת יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶם֩ לְזֶ֨רַע הַשָּׂדֶ֧ה וּֽלְאָכְלְכֶ֛ם וְלַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֖ם וְלֶאֱכֹ֥ל לְטַפְּכֶֽם׃
context_detail: food retained from the harvest for household consumption
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ולאכלכם ולאשר בבתיכם ולאכל לטפכם
working_translation: for your food, for those in your households, and for your little ones to eat
classification_note: The infinitive לאכל makes consumption by the little ones the immediate function.

verse_text: וְכֹל֙ בֵּ֣ית יֹוסֵ֔ף וְאֶחָ֖יו וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יו רַ֗ק טַפָּם֙ וְצֹאנָ֣ם וּבְקָרָ֔ם עָזְב֖וּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: dependants left in Goshen during the funeral journey
relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק טפם וצאנם ובקרם עזבו בארץ גשן
working_translation: they left only their little ones, flocks, and herds in the land of Goshen
classification_note: The little ones remain in the settled place while the adults travel to Canaan.

verse_text: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־תִּירָ֔אוּ אָנֹכִ֛י אֲכַלְכֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְאֶֽת־טַפְּכֶ֑ם וַיְנַחֵ֣ם אֹותָ֔ם וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־לִבָּֽם׃
context_detail: Joseph's promise of continuing material support
relevant_hebrew_phrase: אנכי אכלכל אתכם ואת־טפכם
working_translation: I myself will provide for you and your little ones
classification_note: The verb אכלכל, 'I will provide', directly governs the brothers and their little ones.

verse_text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם יְהִ֨י כֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְאֶֽת־טַפְּכֶ֑ם רְא֕וּ כִּ֥י רָעָ֖ה נֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: Pharaoh's sarcastic rejection of a departure with dependants
relevant_hebrew_phrase: יהי כן יהוה עמכם כאשר אשלח אתכם ואת־טפכם
working_translation: May YHWH indeed be with you if I ever let you and your household dependants go
classification_note: The issue is who may leave Egypt; טף summarizes the dependent household members included in the proposed departure.

verse_text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְכוּ֙ עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה רַ֛ק צֹאנְכֶ֥ם וּבְקַרְכֶ֖ם יֻצָּ֑ג גַּֽם־טַפְּכֶ֖ם יֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּכֶֽם׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: permission for dependants to depart while livestock is retained
relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק צאנכם ובקרכם יצג גם־טפכם ילך עמכם
working_translation: only your flocks and herds must remain; your household dependants may also go with you
classification_note: The verb ילך and prepositional phrase עמכם make accompanied movement explicit.

verse_text: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֖ס סֻכֹּ֑תָה כְּשֵׁשׁ־מֵאֹ֨ות אֶ֧לֶף רַגְלִ֛י הַגְּבָרִ֖ים לְבַ֥ד מִטָּֽף׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: the exodus population counted apart from adult men
relevant_hebrew_phrase: כשש־מאות אלף רגלי הגברים לבד מטף
working_translation: about six hundred thousand adult men on foot, apart from the household dependants
classification_note: Because הגברים counts the adult men, מטף most naturally covers the accompanying dependent population rather than one precise age band.

verse_text: וְלָמָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה מֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜נוּ אֶל־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לִנְפֹּ֣ל בַּחֶ֔רֶב נָשֵׁ֥ינוּ וְטַפֵּ֖נוּ יִהְי֣וּ לָבַ֑ז הֲלֹ֧וא טֹ֦וב לָ֖נוּ שׁ֥וּב מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
context_detail: feared capture during attempted conquest
relevant_hebrew_phrase: נשינו וטפנו יהיו לבז
working_translation: our wives and our little ones will become plunder
classification_note: The feared predicate יהיו לבז, 'will become plunder', determines the primary frame.

verse_text: וְטַ֨פְּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהֵבֵיאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְאַסְתֶּ֖ם בָּֽהּ׃
context_detail: divine reversal of the feared capture
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וטפכם אשר אמרתם לבז יהיה והביאתי אתם
working_translation: your little ones, whom you said would become plunder—I will bring them in
classification_note: The verse reverses the threat of capture, but לבז still supplies the local contrast and therefore the primary frame.

verse_text: וַיֵּעָל֗וּ מֵעַ֧ל מִשְׁכַּן־קֹ֛רֶח דָּתָ֥ן וַאֲבִירָ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב וְדָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם יָצְא֣וּ נִצָּבִ֗ים פֶּ֚תַח אָֽהֳלֵיהֶ֔ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם וְטַפָּֽם׃
context_detail: households exposed to the judgment of Korah's company
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ודתן ואבירם יצאו נצבים פתח אהליהם ונשיהם ובניהם וטפם
working_translation: Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrances of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones
classification_note: The list locates the little ones within households about to be overtaken by divine judgment; it is not a neutral assembly.

verse_text: וַיִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־טַפָּ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־בְּהֶמְתָּ֧ם וְאֶת־כָּל־מִקְנֵהֶ֛ם וְאֶת־כָּל־חֵילָ֖ם בָּזָֽזוּ׃
context_detail: capture of Midian's civilian population
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישבו בני־ישראל את־נשי מדין ואת־טפם
working_translation: the Israelites took captive the women of Midian and their little ones
classification_note: The verb וישבו, 'they took captive', directly governs both groups.

verse_text: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִרְג֥וּ כָל־זָכָ֖ר בַּטָּ֑ף וְכָל־אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃
context_detail: order to kill male children among the captives
relevant_hebrew_phrase: הרגו כל־זכר בטף
taph_rendering: the male children among the little ones
working_translation: kill every male among the little ones
classification_note: The phrase זכר בטף explicitly selects the male subset within the collective טף.

verse_text: וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃
context_detail: order to spare female children among the captives
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וכל הטף בנשים אשר לא־ידעו משכב זכר החיו לכם
taph_rendering: the female children among the little ones
working_translation: but all the female children among the little ones who have not known sexual relations with a male—keep alive for yourselves
classification_note: The phrase הטף בנשים selects the female subset of טף and contrasts their survival with the killing ordered in the preceding verse.

verse_text: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַ֣יֹּאמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: settlements prepared for dependants east of the Jordan
relevant_hebrew_phrase: גדרת צאן נבנה למקננו פה וערים לטפנו
working_translation: we will build sheepfolds here for our livestock and towns for our household dependants
classification_note: The towns provide settled protection while the fighting men cross the Jordan.

verse_text: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם־הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל־מְקֹומָ֑ם וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֨נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: protected residence during the Transjordanian military campaign
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישב טפנו בערי המבצר מפני ישבי הארץ
working_translation: our household dependants will remain in the fortified towns because of the inhabitants of the land
classification_note: The verbs and location describe noncombatants remaining under protection while the armed men depart.

verse_text: בְּנֽוּ־לָכֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: towns built for dependants before military departure
relevant_hebrew_phrase: בנו־לכם ערים לטפכם וגדרת לצנאכם
working_translation: build towns for your household dependants and enclosures for your flocks
classification_note: This instruction repeats the settlement arrangement of Numbers 32:16–17.

verse_text: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ־שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: little ones and wives left in the Gileadite towns
relevant_hebrew_phrase: טפנו נשינו מקננו וכל־בהמתנו יהיו־שם בערי הגלעד
working_translation: our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain there in the towns of Gilead
classification_note: Here wives are listed separately, so 'little ones' is more precise than the broader 'dependants'.

verse_text: וְטַפְּכֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יָדְע֤וּ הַיֹּום֙ טֹ֣וב וָרָ֔ע הֵ֖מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ שָׁ֑מָּה וְלָהֶ֣ם אֶתְּנֶ֔נָּה וְהֵ֖ם יִירָשֽׁוּהָ׃
context_detail: reversal of the wilderness generation's fear of capture
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וטפכם אשר אמרתם לבז יהיה ובניכם אשר לא־ידעו היום טוב ורע המה יבאו שמה
working_translation: your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, and your sons who today do not know good from evil—they will enter there
classification_note: The verse recalls the threatened-plunder formula while promising the younger generation entry into the land.

verse_text: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־כָּל־עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַֽנַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת־כָּל־עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּ֑ף לֹ֥א הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ שָׂרִֽיד׃
context_detail: the population of Sihon's towns placed under the ban
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ונחרם את־כל־עיר מתם והנשים והטף לא השארנו שריד
working_translation: we put every town under the ban—men, women, and little ones; we left no survivor
classification_note: The verb ונחרם and the statement that no survivor remained make this a case of lethal conquest, not merely population movement.

verse_text: וַנַּחֲרֵ֣ם אֹותָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ינוּ לְסִיחֹ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבֹּ֑ון הַחֲרֵם֙ כָּל־עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃
context_detail: the population of Og's towns placed under the ban
relevant_hebrew_phrase: החרם כל־עיר מתם הנשים והטף
working_translation: putting every town under the ban—men, women, and little ones
classification_note: As in Deuteronomy 2:34, טף occurs inside the population formula governed by החרם.

verse_text: רַ֠ק נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם וְטַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵכֶם֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־מִקְנֶ֥ה רַ֖ב לָכֶ֑ם יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: families remaining in Transjordan while the fighting men cross
relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק נשיכם וטפכם ומקנכם ידעתי כי־מקנה רב לכם ישבו בעריכם אשר נתתי לכם
working_translation: only your wives, your little ones, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—shall remain in the towns that I have given you
classification_note: The little ones are part of the noncombatant household population that remains settled.

verse_text: רַ֣ק הַ֠נָּשִׁים וְהַטַּ֨ף וְהַבְּהֵמָ֜ה וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בָעִ֛יר כָּל־שְׁלָלָ֖הּ תָּבֹ֣ז לָ֑ךְ וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֙ אֶת־שְׁלַ֣ל אֹיְבֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃
context_detail: women and little ones treated as spoil after a city's defeat

verse_text: טַפְּכֶ֣ם נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וְגֵ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֑יךָ מֵחֹטֵ֣ב עֵצֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד שֹׁאֵ֥ב מֵימֶֽיךָ׃

verse_text: הַקְהֵ֣ל אֶת־הָעָ֗ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְהַנָּשִׁים֙ וְהַטַּ֔ף וְגֵרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֨עַן יִשְׁמְע֜וּ וּלְמַ֣עַן יִלְמְד֗וּ וְיָֽרְאוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָֽׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשֹׂ֔ות אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתֹּורָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

relevant_hebrew_phrase: הקהל את־העם האנשים והנשים והטף וגרך אשר בשעריך למען ישמעו ולמען ילמדו

verse_text: נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם טַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵיכֶם֒ יֵשְׁב֕וּ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֩ תַּעַבְר֨וּ חֲמֻשִׁ֜ים לִפְנֵ֣י אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל גִּבֹּורֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּ֖ם אֹותָֽם׃

verse_text: לֹֽא־הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֔ר מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־קָרָ֜א יְהֹושֻׁ֗עַ נֶ֣גֶד כָּל־קְהַ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְהַנָּשִׁ֣ים וְהַטַּ֔ף וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַהֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃ פ

classification_note: The phrase identifies the little ones as present within the audience before whom Joshua reads Moses' command.

verse_text: וַיִּפְנ֖וּ וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיָּשִׂ֨ימוּ אֶת־הַטַּ֧ף וְאֶת־הַמִּקְנֶ֛ה וְאֶת־הַכְּבוּדָּ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

working_translation: they placed the little ones, the livestock, and the goods ahead of them
classification_note: The little ones' position within the moving convoy is the immediate narrative concern.

verse_text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁ֣ם הָעֵדָ֗ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וַיְצַוּ֨וּ אֹותָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְהִכִּיתֶ֞ם אֶת־יֹושְׁבֵ֨י יָבֵ֤שׁ גִּלְעָד֙ לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃
context_detail: an ordered punitive massacre at Jabesh-gilead
relevant_hebrew_phrase: לכו והכיתם את־יושבי יבש גלעד לפי־חרב והנשים והטף
working_translation: go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, including the women and the little ones
classification_note: Women and little ones fall within the stated scope of the lethal command.

verse_text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־אִתַּ֖י לֵ֣ךְ וַעֲבֹ֑ר וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֞ר אִתַּ֤י הַגִּתִּי֙ וְכָל־אֲנָשָׁ֔יו וְכָל־הַטַּ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתֹּֽו׃

working_translation: Ittai the Gittite crossed over with all his men and all the little ones who were with him
classification_note: The little ones accompany a displaced military retinue rather than participate as combatants.

verse_text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל־שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה הֵ֚מָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־הִפְקִ֧יד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־אֲחִיקָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכִ֣י׀ הִפְקִ֣יד אִתֹּ֗ו אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וָטָ֔ף וּמִדַּלַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הָגְל֖וּ בָּבֶֽלָה׃

classification_note: The little ones belong to the non-exiled civilian remnant; displacement and remaining in the land dominate the setting.

verse_text: וַיִּקַּח֩ יֹוחָנָ֨ן בֶּן־קָרֵ֜חַ וְכָל־שָׂרֵ֧י הַחֲיָלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־אִתֹּ֗ו אֵ֣ת כָּל־שְׁאֵרִ֤ית הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֠שִׁיב מֵאֵ֨ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֤אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה֙ מִן־הַמִּצְפָּ֔ה אַחַ֣ר הִכָּ֔ה אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֖ה בֶּן־אֲחִיקָ֑ם גְּבָרִ֞ים אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְנָשִׁ֤ים וְטַף֙ וְסָ֣רִסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵשִׁ֖יב מִגִּבְעֹֽון׃
context_detail: civilians recovered from a political captor
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ונשים וטף וסרסים אשר השיב מגבעון
working_translation: and women, little ones, and court officials whom he brought back from Gibeon
classification_note: The repeated השיב describes recovery from Ishmael's captivity, so the earlier movement classification understated the conflict setting.

verse_text: אֶֽת־הַ֠גְּבָרִים וְאֶת־הַנָּשִׁ֣ים וְאֶת־הַטַּף֮ וְאֶת־בְּנֹ֣ות הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנִּ֨יחַ֙ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֣ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֔ים אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁפָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא וְאֶת־בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן־נֵרִיָּֽהוּ׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: the surviving population taken in the flight to Egypt
relevant_hebrew_phrase: את־הגברים ואת־הנשים ואת־הטף ואת־בנות המלך ואת כל־הנפש אשר הניח נבוזראדן
working_translation: the men, the women, the little ones, the king's daughters, and every person whom Nebuzaradan had left behind
classification_note: Within Jeremiah 43:5–7 this enumerated remnant is taken to Egypt, making forced displacement the controlling episode.

verse_text: זָקֵ֡ן בָּח֣וּר וּבְתוּלָה֩ וְטַ֨ף וְנָשִׁ֜ים תַּהַרְג֣וּ לְמַשְׁחִ֗ית וְעַל־כָּל־אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָ֤יו הַתָּו֙ אַל־תִּגַּ֔שׁוּ וּמִמִּקְדָּשִׁ֖י תָּחֵ֑לּוּ וַיָּחֵ֨לּוּ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃
context_detail: visionary judgment against Jerusalem's population
relevant_hebrew_phrase: זקן בחור ובתולה וטף ונשים תהרגו למשחית
working_translation: old man, young man, young woman, little ones, and women—you shall kill them to destruction
classification_note: The imperative תהרגו includes טף in the population exposed to visionary judgment.

verse_text: וְנִשְׁלֹ֨וחַ סְפָרִ֜ים בְּיַ֣ד הָרָצִים֮ אֶל־כָּל־מְדִינֹ֣ות הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ לְהַשְׁמִ֡יד לַהֲרֹ֣ג וּלְאַבֵּ֣ד אֶת־כָּל־הַ֠יְּהוּדִים מִנַּ֨עַר וְעַד־זָקֵ֨ן טַ֤ף וְנָשִׁים֙ בְּיֹ֣ום אֶחָ֔ד בִּשְׁלֹושָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לְחֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא־חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֑ר וּשְׁלָלָ֖ם לָבֹֽוז׃
context_detail: the royal decree to annihilate the Jews
relevant_hebrew_phrase: להשמיד להרג ולאבד את־כל־היהודים מנער ועד־זקן טף ונשים ביום אחד
working_translation: to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the Jews, from youth to old man, little ones and women, in a single day
classification_note: The little ones are explicitly included in the target population of the annihilation decree.

verse_text: אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לַיְּהוּדִ֣ים׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּכָל־עִיר־וָעִ֗יר לְהִקָּהֵל֮ וְלַעֲמֹ֣ד עַל־נַפְשָׁם֒ לְהַשְׁמִיד֩ וְלַהֲרֹ֨ג וּלְאַבֵּ֜ד אֶת־כָּל־חֵ֨יל עַ֧ם וּמְדִינָ֛ה הַצָּרִ֥ים אֹתָ֖ם טַ֣ף וְנָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלָלָ֖ם לָבֹֽוז׃
context_detail: the counter-decree authorizing lethal defense and plunder
relevant_hebrew_phrase: להקהל ולעמד על־נפשם להשמיד ולהרג ולאבד את־כל־חיל עם ומדינה הצרים אתם טף ונשים
working_translation: to assemble and stand for their lives, and to destroy, kill, and annihilate every armed force of people or province attacking them, including little ones and women
classification_note: Although להקהל occurs, this is armed mobilization. The syntax of הצרים אתם טף ונשים is disputed: the working translation includes little ones and women among those exposed to the counter-decree, while another reading takes them as the women and children of the Jews whom the armed force attacks. Either reading belongs in the conflict frame.

verse_text: וָאֶקְרָ֨א שָׁ֥ם צֹום֙ עַל־הַנָּהָ֣ר אַהֲוָ֔א לְהִתְעַנֹּ֖ות לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ וּלְטַפֵּ֖נוּ וּלְכָל־רְכוּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
context_detail: a fast seeking divine protection for a journey
relevant_hebrew_phrase: לבקש ממנו דרך ישרה לנו ולטפנו ולכל־רכושנו
working_translation: to seek from him a safe road for us, our little ones, and all our possessions
classification_note: The requested דרך ישרה concerns safe travel for the full caravan, including the little ones.

verse_text: וְכֹ֨ל־יְהוּדָ֔ה עֹמְדִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה גַּם־טַפָּ֖ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֵיהֶֽם׃ פ
context_detail: the whole community standing before YHWH in crisis
relevant_hebrew_phrase: וכל־יהודה עמדים לפני יהוה גם־טפם נשיהם ובניהם
working_translation: all Judah was standing before YHWH, including their small children, their wives, and their sons
classification_note: The little ones are present in a communal act of standing before YHWH; their distinction from בנים supports the narrower rendering 'small children'.

verse_text: וּלְהִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּכָל־טַפָּ֧ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֥ם וּבְנֹותֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָתָ֖ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
context_detail: genealogical registration for cultic distributions
relevant_hebrew_phrase: ולהתיחש בכל־טפם נשיהם ובניהם ובנותיהם לכל־קהל
working_translation: and [the genealogical enrollment included] all their small children, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—the whole assembly
classification_note: The governing infinitive להתיחש denotes genealogical enrollment, not attendance at an assembly; the frame records institutional inclusion in the cultic distribution system.
